An '''Ishi Tib pirate''' was a member of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]], serving aboard the [[Acushnet/Legends|''Acushnet'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] acted as the navigator for a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|pirate saucer]] under the command of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]]. Hondo wanted to board the Jedi ship [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']] in order to steal the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] that were on board. This pirate was wary of this but Hondo talked him into it by revealing they were just children.

When the ''Crucible'' was boarded, this pirate assisted in searching for the crystals and the occupants of the ship. To get rid of the pirates, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] ordered trainee [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] to activate the re-powered engines and break apart from the pirate vessel. This caused a vacuum which proceeded to suck all of the pirates, this one included, out of the ''Crucible''. While most of the pirates were unlucky and sucked into space, this pirate, along with Hondo, Gwarm, and several others managed to grab hold of part of the pirate shuttle's connecting bridge. In the end, Ahsoka was captured by the pirates and the ''Crucible'' blasted off into hyperspace, unaware that Ahsoka was not on board.

==Behind the scenes==
This pirate was designed by Chris Glenn according to Star Wars.com's concept art gallery. This pirate was also based on a design created for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].

This pirate is one of the few members of the Ohnaka Gang who was not a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]; other known pirates who were not Weequay are two other [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]].
